updates.note: Management stated they expect the working capital cycle to normalize to 50 to 55 days in the coming quarters.
updates.quote: We expect this to normalize to our long-term steady range of 50 to 55 days in the coming quarters.

updates.note: Export contribution was mentioned as 6% for the quarter, but the long-term target was not restated.
Reiterated Project Spring target of FMEG EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30.
updates.quote: achieve our Project Spring targets of 1.5x - 2x industry growth and EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30

new_promises.statement: Annual capital expenditure through FY30 is guided at 12 billion to 16 billion.
new_promises.quote: Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion to ₹ 16 billion annually through FY30.
new_promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

new_promises.statement: FMEG segment to achieve 1.5x to 2x industry growth by FY30.
new_promises.quote: Project Spring targets of 1.5x - 2x industry growth and EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30
new_promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

new_promises.statement: BharatNet scheme is expected to generate 4.5 billion over the next 3 years for project execution.

new_promises.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
